vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-131774
vulnerabilities.description: A Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability, described as Improper Neutralization of Input during Web Page Generation, exists in the WooCommerce Fortnox Integration plugin in all versions up to and including 4.8.1. This allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the website's database, which execute in a user's browser when the stored data is rendered.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-131773
vulnerabilities.description: A Missing Authorization vulnerability exists in the WooCommerce Fortnox Integration plugin in all versions up to and including 4.8.1. This flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform unauthorized actions by bypassing access control checks, potentially leading to manipulation of plugin settings or data.

indicators.name: WooCommerce Fortnox Integration XSS Attempt (CVE-2026-131774)
indicators.pattern:
title: WooCommerce Fortnox Integration XSS Attempt (CVE-2026-131774)
id: 7b8c9d0e-1f2a-4b5c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects potential attempts to exploit the Stored XSS vulnerability (CVE-2026-131774) in the WooCommerce Fortnox Integration WordPress plugin.
  This rule looks for common XSS payloads in web requests related to the plugin's functionality.
references:
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-131774
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-22
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_context:
    c-uri|contains:
      - 'woocommerce-fortnox-integration'
      - 'fortnox'
  selection_payload:
    c-uri-query|contains:
      - '<script'
      - 'onerror='
      - 'onload='
      - 'alert('
      - 'javascript:'
    # Note: Searching POST bodies is not standardized in Sigma, but some backends may apply c-uri-query to it.
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: This indicator detects web requests containing common XSS payloads targeting URLs associated with the WooCommerce Fortnox Integration plugin, suggesting an attempt to exploit CVE-2026-131774.
